title: Procurement-decisions DecisionContext + per-field provenance
description: Canonical contract between the substrate adapter (producer) and the Inspect AI eval loop (consumer). The substrate adapter emits a DecisionContext PER RECORD shaped for MeshQu /v1/decisions/record, AND a parallel per-field provenance envelope captured in substrate_notes for the decision_traces.jsonl audit row. Two schemas in one file: `DecisionContext` (what MeshQu sees, flat fields, hash-bound) and `SubstrateProvenance` (what the writeup sees, per-field source/confidence, hash-excluded). The provenance envelope is deliberately separate from the DecisionContext so the policy rules continue to read primitive values (number/string) rather than envelope objects — and so the receipt's integrity hash binds the substantive fields without coupling to substrate-internal metadata.

DecisionContext.description: Payload passed to MeshQu /v1/decisions/record. `context.fields` carries the flat policy-evaluable field set; `context.metadata` carries operational annotations that the receipt's integrity hash deliberately excludes (per the 2026-05-14 codebase-audit corrections in planning/decision_log.md — only `fields` is hashed, `metadata` is stripped before hashing).

decision_type.description: Locked to `procurement_decision` for the experiment. Selects which policies in the experiment-procurement tenant evaluate this record.

fields.description: Flat field set the ratified policy's 6 rules evaluate against. Booleans MUST be the strings 'true'/'false' to match the policy's when-clause authoring (decision_log F13 cross-over finding); flipping to JSON booleans silently breaks rule firing.

publication_delay_days.description: PROC-001-S53. (awards[0].datePublished − awards[0].date) in days. Award date is the substrate proxy for contract signature date.

above_threshold.description: PROC-001-S53, PROC-005 when. Proxy: tender.value.amount (or awards[0].value.amount fallback) > £139,000 (PA23 Schedule 1 sub-central services threshold).

supplier_id.description: PROC-003. awards[0].suppliers[0].id (canonicalised: trimmed, original casing preserved).

conflict_of_interest_declaration.description: PROC-004 (presence). NOT IN OCDS — emitted only when a future substrate variant derives it from a richer source. Today: omitted, PROC-004 cannot fire.

procurement_method_open_flag.description: PROC-005 (presence). Emitted as the string 'true' when tender.procurementMethod == 'open'. Omitted when procurement method is anything else — the presence rule fires when the flag is absent + the when clause matches.

direct_award_justification_present.description: PROC-005 when. Heuristic: derived from relatedProcesses tagged 'transparency' or 'directAward'. False-negatives possible where the notice exists but isn't linked.

is_modification.description: PROC-006 when. Derived from OCDS tag (contractAmendment / awardAmendment / modification).

modification_value_ratio.description: PROC-006. (amendments[0].value.amount / original contract value). Only emitted when both numerator and denominator are derivable. NULL allowed when not a modification — see no-silent-defaults rule.

metadata.description: Operational annotations stripped from the receipt's integrity hash. Carries OCDS provenance + adapter version for the writeup's reproducibility statement.

ocid.description: OCDS Open Contracting ID for the source record. Strictly informational for the receipt; the writeup uses it to cross-reference back to Contracts Finder.

adapter_version.description: substrate.py's ADAPTER_VERSION at production time. Bumped on substantive derivation changes.

SubstrateProvenance.description: Per-field source + confidence metadata. Produced alongside the DecisionContext by the substrate adapter; logged into decision_traces.jsonl's substrate_notes for every record so the writeup can statistically analyse 'disagreement rate on direct fields vs disagreement rate on proxy-derived fields'. NOT sent to MeshQu — substrate-internal.

fields.description: One envelope per field that COULD be emitted (including absent ones). Keys match DecisionContext.fields keys.

FieldProvenance.description: Per-field provenance envelope. Same key set across every record (absent fields explicitly carry status='absent' so coverage statistics are computable).

value.description: The emitted value as it appears in DecisionContext.fields. Omitted for status='absent'. Type matches the field's DecisionContext schema.

status.description: Provenance class. direct_ocds = field copied verbatim from OCDS path. derived = computed from one or more OCDS fields with no methodological proxy (e.g. date arithmetic). proxy = computed using a documented methodological proxy (e.g. award date as signature date). absent = field not derivable from OCDS for this record (always honest — never a silent default).

confidence.description: Substrate confidence in the derivation, NOT model/agent confidence. high = direct OCDS path or trivial arithmetic. medium = proxy with documented limitations. low = heuristic with known false-negative or false-positive modes (e.g. derived_direct_award_justification_present).

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the derivation step or absence reason. Quoted in the writeup's substrate-honesty subsection for the most interesting derivations.
